root_cause: The language selector correctly navigated the current public route to /en/*, but ordinary same-origin page and menu links retained their original unprefixed Dutch href values. Navigating after selecting English therefore left the English locale namespace and returned the visitor to Dutch.
prevention: Treat selected locale as a sitewide navigation invariant, not a page-local translation state.
On English public routes rewrite every eligible same-origin public link to the equivalent /en/* route; on Dutch routes rewrite to the unprefixed canonical route.
Exclude portal, customer portal and technical/API/assets/functions paths from public locale rewriting.
Normalize dynamically inserted menu/navigation links through the same runtime guard.
Terminal browser proof must navigate to another public page after language selection and verify that the selected locale persists.
